sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日简报Dealbook的商业与政策报道。

sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市Dealbook峰会的舞台上现场采访商业、政治和文化领域一些最具影响力的人物，包括万斯、

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the Dealbook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.zh: 你可以实时观看其中一些毫无防备、未经过滤的对话。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.zh: 你一定不想错过。

sentences.en: I'm Nick Casey.
sentences.zh: 我是尼克·凯西。

sentences.en: I'm the Madrid bureau chief at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》马德里分社社长。

sentences.en: When I was growing up, I didn't really know what a dad was in the sense of other people's dads, because the man that I knew as my father was someone that would come and go.
sentences.zh: 在我成长的时候，我其实并不知道什么是父亲，不像别人的父亲那样，因为我所认识的父亲是一个会来来去去的人。

sentences.en: He was working on cargo ships then.
sentences.zh: 他当时在货轮上工作。

sentences.en: So he was a bit like this kind of magical pirate who came from the sea, showed up for a few days, and then was gone again.
sentences.zh: 所以他有点像那种从海里来的神奇海盗，出现几天，然后又消失了。

sentences.en: His next ship would take him out to Manila or to Australia or to Alaska.
sentences.zh: 他的下一艘船会把他带到马尼拉、澳大利亚或阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: We never knew where.
sentences.zh: 我们从来不知道是哪里。

sentences.en: And then one day he came, and after he saw us, we never saw him again.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天他来了，在我们见了他之后，我们就再也没有见过他。

sentences.en: And I wanted some answers.
sentences.zh: 我想要一些答案。

sentences.en: I wanted to know who he was.
sentences.zh: 我想知道他是谁。

sentences.en: I wanted to know anything I could about him.
sentences.zh: 我想知道关于他的一切。

sentences.en: And that was kind of the beginning of this search, which lasted a lot of my life to try to find out who he was, but more importantly, like where he was and if he was still alive.
sentences.zh: 这可以说是这场寻找的开始，它持续了我生命中的大部分时间，试图找出他是谁，但更重要的是，他在哪里，以及他是否还活着。

sentences.en: And we realized actually, my mother and I, we had very little information to go on.
sentences.zh: 后来我们发现，实际上，我和母亲几乎没有什么线索可循。

sentences.en: I spent a lot of years trying to find this man, any scraps of information I could, any memories about him.
sentences.zh: 我花了多年时间试图找到这个人，搜集任何能找到的零星信息、任何关于他的记忆。

sentences.en: I spent a lot of time thinking about what it might be like the day that I actually found him again.
sentences.zh: 我花了大量时间想象我真正再次找到他的那一天会是什么样子。

sentences.en: I wondered whether I would be mad, whether I would be happy.
sentences.zh: 我想知道我会生气，还是会高兴。

sentences.en: And then four years ago, I finally found him.
sentences.zh: 而在四年前，我终于找到了他。

sentences.en: And I wrote about it for the magazine, just in time for Father's Day.
sentences.zh: 我为这本杂志写了这件事，正好赶上父亲节。

sentences.en: So here's my story,
sentences.zh: 所以，这是我的故事，

sentences.en: Finding My Father, read by William DeMeritt.
sentences.zh: 《寻找我的父亲》，由威廉·德梅里特朗读。

sentences.en: This was recorded by Autumn.
sentences.zh: 这段录音由Autumn制作。

sentences.en: Autumn is an app you can download to listen to lots of audio stories from publications such as The New York Times, The New Yorker, Vanity Fair, and The Atlantic.
sentences.zh: Autumn是一个你可以下载的应用，用来收听来自《纽约时报》、《纽约客》、《名利场》和《大西洋月刊》等出版物的许多音频故事。

sentences.en: Somehow it was always my mother who answered the phone when he called.
sentences.zh: 不知为何，每次他打电话来，总是我的母亲接听电话。

sentences.en: I remember his voice on the other end of the line, muffled in the receiver against her ear.
sentences.zh: 我记得他在电话那头声音沉闷，听筒紧紧贴在她耳边的接收器上。

sentences.en: Her eyes, just starting to show their wrinkles in those days, would fill with the memories that she shared with this man.
sentences.zh: 她的眼睛在那个时期刚开始显现皱纹，此时会充满她与这个男人共同拥有的回忆。

sentences.en: She would put out her cigarette, grab a sheet of paper, and scribble down the address.
sentences.zh: 她会掐灭香烟，抓过一张纸，潦草地记下地址。

sentences.en: She would put down the receiver and look up at me.
sentences.zh: 她放下听筒，抬头看着我。

sentences.en: It's your dad, she would say.
sentences.zh: 是你的爸爸，她会说。

sentences.en: I slept in a twin bed in the living room, and I would start jumping on it, seeing if I could reach the ceiling of our mobile home with my tiny fingers.
sentences.zh: 我睡在起居室的一张单人床上，然后开始在上面跳跃，看看我的小手指能不能够到我们移动房屋的天花板。

sentences.en: My mother would put on some makeup and fish out a pair of earrings from a tangle in the basket next to the bathroom sink.
sentences.zh: 我母亲会化点妆，从浴室水槽旁边篮子的乱麻中挑出一副耳环。

sentences.en: Moments later, we would be racing down the highway with the windows rolled down.
sentences.zh: 片刻之后，我们就会摇下车窗，在高速公路上飞驰。

sentences.en: I remember the salty air coming across San Francisco Bay, the endless cables of the suspension bridges and the heat.
sentences.zh: 我记得吹过旧金山湾的咸湿空气、悬索桥无尽的缆绳以及热浪。

sentences.en: There would be a meeting point somewhere outside a dockyard or in a parking lot near a pier.
sentences.zh: 在造船厂外某个地方或码头附近的停车场会有一个碰头点。

sentences.en: And then there would be my dad.
sentences.zh: 然后我的爸爸就会出现。

sentences.en: He would be visiting again from some faraway place where the ships on which he worked had taken him.
sentences.zh: 他会再次从他工作的船只所带他去的某个遥远地方来探访。

sentences.en: It might have been Alaska.
sentences.zh: 可能是阿拉斯加。

sentences.en: Sometimes it was Seoul or Manila.
sentences.zh: 有时是首尔或马尼拉。

sentences.en: His stories were endless, his voice booming.
sentences.zh: 他的故事讲个没完，声音洪亮。

sentences.en: But I just wanted to see him.
sentences.zh: 但我只想见到他。

sentences.en: Wanted him to pick me up with his big, thick-set hands that were calloused from all the years
sentences.zh: 希望他用那双因在机舱工作多年而满是老茧的大手把我抱起来，

sentences.en: in the engine room and put me on his shoulders where I could look out over the water with him.
sentences.zh: 把我放在他的肩膀上，我和他一起眺望水面。

sentences.en: From that height, I could work my fingers through his hair, black and curly like mine.
sentences.zh: 从那个高度，我可以把手指插进他的头发里，那是和我一样乌黑卷曲的头发。

sentences.en: He had the beard that I would grow one day.
sentences.zh: 他有着我日后才会长出的胡子。

sentences.en: There was the smell of sweat and cologne on his dark skin.
sentences.zh: 他黝黑的皮肤上有着汗水和古龙水的味道。

sentences.en: I remember one day when we met him at the dockyard in Oakland.
sentences.zh: 我记得有一天我们在奥克兰的造船厂与他见面。

sentences.en: He got into our old Volkswagen Bug and soon we were heading back down the highway to our home.
sentences.zh: 他上了我们那辆旧大众甲壳虫汽车，不久我们就沿着高速公路返回我们的家。

sentences.en: He was rummaging through his bag, pulling something out.
sentences.zh: 他在包里翻找着，掏出了一件东西。

sentences.en: A tiny glass bottle.
sentences.zh: 一个精致的小玻璃瓶。

sentences.en: What's that?
sentences.zh: 那是什么？

sentences.en: I asked him.
sentences.zh: 我问他。

sentences.en: It's my medicine, kid.
sentences.zh: 那是我的药，孩子。

sentences.en: He said.
sentences.zh: 他说。

sentences.en: Don't listen to him, Nico, my mother said.
sentences.zh: 别听他的，尼科，我母亲说。

sentences.en: That's not his medicine.
sentences.zh: 那不是他的药。

sentences.en: She smiled.
sentences.zh: 她笑了笑。

sentences.en: Things felt right that day.
sentences.zh: 那天感觉一切都很对劲。

sentences.en: My father never stayed for more than a few days.
sentences.zh: 我的父亲从未停留超过几天。

sentences.en: Before long, I would start to miss him.
sentences.zh: 没过多久，我就会开始想念他。

sentences.en: And it seemed to me that my mother did too.
sentences.zh: 在我看来，我母亲也是如此。

sentences.en: To her, he represented an entire life she had given up to raise me.
sentences.zh: 对他来说，他代表了她为了抚养我而放弃的整个人生。

sentences.en: She would step on my mattress and reach onto a shelf to pull down a yellow spiral photo album that had pictures of when she worked on ships too.
sentences.zh: 她会踩上我的床垫，够到架子上取下一本黄色的螺旋相册，里面有她也曾在船上工作时的照片。

sentences.en: It told the story of how they met.
sentences.zh: 它讲述了他们是如何相遇的故事。

sentences.en: The book began with a postcard of a satellite image taken from miles above an inky sea.
sentences.zh: 这本书以一张明信片开篇，那是一张从墨黑色海面上空数英里处拍摄的卫星图像。

sentences.en: There were wisps of clouds and long trails of ships heading towards something large at the center.
sentences.zh: 画面上有缕缕云彩和长长的船只航迹，正驶向正中心某个巨大的东西。

sentences.en: My mom told me this was called an atoll, a kind of island made of coral.
sentences.zh: 我妈妈告诉我，这叫环礁，是一种由珊瑚构成的岛屿。

sentences.en: Diego Garcia, she said.
sentences.zh: 迪戈加西亚，她说。

sentences.en: The place where we made you.
sentences.zh: 我们孕育你的地方。

sentences.en: By 1983, when my mom reached Diego Garcia, she had lived many lives already.
sentences.zh: 到1983年我妈妈到达迪戈加西亚时，她已经经历过许多段人生。

sentences.en: She had been married for a couple of years.
sentences.zh: 她已经结婚几年了。

sentences.en: The only thing I kept from that marriage was my last name, she said.
sentences.zh: 我从那场婚姻中保留的唯一东西就是我的姓氏，她说。

sentences.en: Worked on an assembly line, sold oil paintings, spent time as an accountant and tended bar in places including Puerto Rico, where she lived for a while in the 1970s.
sentences.zh: 在流水线上工作过，卖过油画，当过会计，还在包括波多黎各在内的地方当过酒保，她曾在20世纪70年代在那里住过一段时间。

sentences.en: Then on a lark, she decided to go to sea.
sentences.zh: 然后出于一时兴起，她决定出海。

sentences.en: She joined the National Maritime Union, which represented cargo ship workers.
sentences.zh: 她加入了代表货轮工人的全国海员工会。

sentences.en: Eventually, she signed on for a six-month stint as an ordinary seaman on a ship called The Bay,
sentences.zh: 最终，她签下一份为期六个月的合同，在一艘名为“海湾”号的船上担任普通水手，

sentences.en: which was destined for Diego Garcia, an island in the Indian Ocean with a large military base.
sentences.zh: 该船的目的地是印度洋上一个设有大型军事基地的岛屿——迪戈加西亚。

sentences.en: The next picture in the album shows her on the deck of the bay, not long before she met my father.
sentences.zh: 相册里的下一张照片显示她在海湾号的甲板上，那是在她遇到我父亲不久前。

sentences.en: She's 37, with freckled white skin, a seaman's cap, and a large fish she has pulled out of the water.
sentences.zh: 她37岁，有着满是雀斑的白皙皮肤、一顶水手帽，手里拉着一条从水里拉出来的大鱼。

sentences.en: There are rows of bent palm trees, tropical birds swimming across the waves.
sentences.zh: 那里有一排排弯曲的棕榈树，热带鸟类在波浪间游弋。

sentences.en: That watery landscape was just the kind of place you would picture for a whirlwind romance.
sentences.zh: 那片水域风景正是你会为一段旋风般的浪漫所设想的地方。

sentences.en: But it turned out my parents spent only one night together, not exactly intending to.
sentences.zh: 但事实证明，我的父母只在一起过夜了一晚，并非完全出于本意。

sentences.en: My father had been working on another ship moored off the island.
sentences.zh: 我父亲一直在停泊在岛外的一艘船上工作。

sentences.en: One afternoon before my mother was set to head home, they were both ashore when a storm hit.
sentences.zh: 在我母亲准备回家那天的一个下午，两人都在岸上时遭遇了一场风暴。

sentences.en: They were ferried to his ship, but the sea was too choppy for her to continue onto the bay.
sentences.zh: 他们被渡船送到他的船上，但海面风浪太大，她无法继续前往海湾号。

sentences.en: She spent the night with him.
sentences.zh: 她和他一起过夜。

sentences.en: When the job on the island was up, my mom took her flight back to the United States.
sentences.zh: 当岛上的工作结束时，我妈妈坐飞机回到了美国。

sentences.en: My father headed for the Philippines.
sentences.zh: 我父亲则前往菲律宾。

sentences.en: Nine months later, when I was born, he was still at sea.
sentences.zh: 九个月后我出生时，他仍在海上。

sentences.en: She put a birth announcement into an envelope and sent it to the Union Hall in San Pedro, asking them to hold it for him.
sentences.zh: 她把一张出生启事塞进信封，寄到圣佩德罗的工会大厅，请他们为他保管。

sentences.en: One day, three months later, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 三个月后的某一天，电话铃响了。

sentences.en: His ship had just docked in the port of Oakland.
sentences.zh: 他的船刚刚停靠在奥克兰港。

sentences.en: The way my mom tells the story, he got to the restaurant before her and ordered some coffee.
sentences.zh: 照我妈妈的说法，他比她先到餐厅并点了一些咖啡。

sentences.en: Then he turned around and saw her clutching me.
sentences.zh: 然后他转过身，看到紧紧抱着我的她。

sentences.en: And it dawned on him that he was my father.
sentences.zh: 他突然意识到自己是我的父亲。

sentences.en: It seemed he hadn't picked up the envelope at the Union Hall in Southern California yet.
sentences.zh: 看来他还没去南加州的工会大厅取那个信封。

sentences.en: He was holding a mug.
sentences.zh: 他手里端着一个马克杯。

sentences.en: His eyes got wide and his hands began to tremble and the hot coffee went all over the floor.
sentences.zh: 他的眼睛睁得很大，双手开始颤抖，热咖啡洒了一地。

sentences.en: I have never seen a black man turn that white, she would say to me.
sentences.zh: 我从未见过一个黑人变得那么白，她常对我说。

sentences.en: She told him that she'd named her son Nicholas after him, and even added his unusual middle name, Wimberley, to mine.
sentences.zh: 她告诉他，她用他的名字给儿子取名为尼古拉斯，甚至把他的中间名温伯利也加到了我的名字里。

sentences.en: Then she handed me over to him and went looking for the restroom.
sentences.zh: 然后她把我交给他，自己去找洗手间了。

sentences.en: She remembers that when she reappeared, my father had stripped me naked.
sentences.zh: 她记得当她重新出现时，我父亲已经把我剥得一丝不挂。

sentences.en: He said he was looking for a birthmark that he claimed all his children had.
sentences.zh: 他说他在找一个他声称他所有孩子都有的胎记。

sentences.en: There it was, a tiny blue one near my tailbone.
sentences.zh: 真的找到了，在我尾椎骨附近有一个微小的蓝色胎记。

sentences.en: It's hard to explain the feeling of seeing this man to people whose fathers were a fixture of their daily lives.
sentences.zh: 对于那些父亲是日常生活中固定陪伴的人来说，很难向他们解释看到这个男人的感受。

sentences.en: I hardly knew what a father was.
sentences.zh: 我几乎不知道父亲是什么。

sentences.en: But whenever he came, it felt like Christmas.
sentences.zh: 但每当他来的时候，感觉就像过圣诞节一样。

sentences.en: He and my mother were suddenly a couple again.
sentences.zh: 他和我的母亲突然又成了一对。

sentences.en: I would sit in the backseat of our old VW watching their silhouettes, feeling complete.
sentences.zh: 我会坐在我们旧大众汽车的后座上看着他们的剪影，感到无比圆满。

sentences.en: Yet the presence of this man also came with moments of fear.
sentences.zh: 然而，这个男人的出现也伴随着恐惧的时刻。

sentences.en: Each visit there seemed to be more to him that I hadn't seen before.
sentences.zh: 每次他来访，似乎总有更多我以前没见过的面貌展现出来。

sentences.en: I remember one of his visits when I was five or six, and we headed to the creek behind the trailer.
sentences.zh: 我记得在我五六岁时他的某次来访，我们朝拖车后面的小溪走去。

sentences.en: The place where many afternoons of my childhood were spent hunting for crawdads and duck feathers and minnows.
sentences.zh: 那是我童年许多下午用来寻找小龙虾、鸭毛和小鲦鱼的地方。

sentences.en: It was warm and almost summer, and the wild fennel had grown taller than me and was blooming with big yellow clusters.
sentences.zh: 天气暖和，近乎夏天，野生茴香长得比我还高，开出了巨大的黄色花簇。

sentences.en: My father's head up where the blooms were, mine several feet below, as I led the way through stalks.
sentences.zh: 我父亲的头在花朵盛开的高处，而我在几英尺下方，领着路穿过茎秆。

sentences.en: I remember having hopped into the creek first when a large blue crawdad appeared, its pincers raised to fight.
sentences.zh: 我记得自己先跳进了小溪，一只巨大的蓝色小龙虾出现，高举着双螯准备迎战。

sentences.en: I froze.
sentences.zh: 我僵住了。

sentences.en: My father yelled,
sentences.zh: 我父亲大喊，

sentences.en: You're a sissy, boy!
sentences.zh: 你个胆小鬼，小子！

sentences.en: You scared?
sentences.zh: 你害怕吗？

sentences.en: His words cut through me.
sentences.zh: 他的话深深刺痛了我。

sentences.en: I forgot the crawdad.
sentences.zh: 我忘了小龙虾的事。

sentences.en: There was an anger in his voice that I'd never heard in my mother's.
sentences.zh: 他的声音里有一种我从未在母亲身上听到过的愤怒。

sentences.en: I started to run away, beating a trail back through the fennel as his voice got louder.
sentences.zh: 我开始逃跑，伴随着他越来越大的声音，在茴香丛中踏出一条路往回跑。

sentences.en: He tried to catch me, but stumbled.
sentences.zh: 他试图抓住我，却绊倒了。

sentences.en: A furious look of pain took control of his face.
sentences.zh: 一张充满痛苦的狂怒面孔占据了他的表情。

sentences.en: I was terrified then, and I left him behind, running for my mother.
sentences.zh: 我当时吓坏了，把他抛在身后，向母亲奔去。

sentences.en: When he made it to the trailer, his foot was gashed open from a piece of glass he'd stepped on.
sentences.zh: 当他走到拖车时，他的脚被踩到的碎玻璃割开了一道大口子。

sentences.en: But strangely, his face was calm.
sentences.zh: 但奇怪的是，他的脸很平静。

sentences.en: I asked if he was going to die.
sentences.zh: 我问他是不是要死了。

sentences.en: He laughed.
sentences.zh: 他笑了。

sentences.en: He told my mom to find a sewing kit, then pulled out a piece of string and what looked like the longest needle I had ever seen.
sentences.zh: 他叫我妈妈找个针线包，然后掏出一根线和看起来我见过最长的针。

sentences.en: I will never forget watching my father patiently sew his foot back together, stitch after stitch, and the words he said after.
sentences.zh: 我永远不会忘记看着父亲耐心地一针一线把自己的脚缝合起来，以及他之后说的话。

sentences.en: A man stitches his own foot.
sentences.zh: 男子汉自己缝合脚伤。

sentences.en: When he was done, he smiled and asked for his medicine.
sentences.zh: 缝好后，他笑了笑，要求要他的药。

sentences.en: He took a big swig from his bottle before he turned back to his foot and washed it clean with the remaining rum.
sentences.zh: 他从瓶子里猛灌了一大口，然后转过身去处理他的脚，用剩下的朗姆酒将其清洗干净。

sentences.en: Then he was gone again.
sentences.zh: 接着他又走了。

sentences.en: That longing was back in my mother, and I had started to see it wasn't exactly for him but for the life she'd had.
sentences.zh: 那种渴望回到了我母亲身上，而我开始看出那其实不是为了他，而是为了她曾经拥有过的人生。

sentences.en: On the shelf above my bed sat a basket of coins that she collected on her travels.
sentences.zh: 在我床上方的架子上，放着一个她旅行时收集硬币的篮子。

sentences.en: We would set them out on a table together.
sentences.zh: 我们会一起把它们摆在桌上。

sentences.en: The Japanese five-yen coins that had holes in the middle.
sentences.zh: 中间有孔的日本五日元硬币。

sentences.en: A silver Australian half-dollar with a kangaroo and an emu standing next to a shield.
sentences.zh: 一枚银质的澳大利亚半元硬币，上面刻有一只袋鼠和一只鸸鹋，它们站在一面盾牌旁边。

sentences.en: The Canadian money had the queen's profile.
sentences.zh: 加拿大钱币上有女王的侧面像。

sentences.en: Soon after my seventh birthday, the phone rang again, and we went to the port.
sentences.zh: 在我七岁生日后不久，电话再次响起，我们去了港口。

sentences.en: We could tell something was off from the start.
sentences.zh: 一开始我们就觉得有点不对劲。

sentences.en: My father took us out to eat and began to explain.
sentences.zh: 我父亲带我们出去吃饭，并开始解释。

sentences.en: He had shot someone.
sentences.zh: 他开枪打死了一个人。

sentences.en: The man was dead.
sentences.zh: 那个人死了。

sentences.en: He was going to be put on trial.
sentences.zh: 他要接受审判。

sentences.en: It sounded bad, he said, but was not a big deal.
sentences.zh: 他说，听起来挺严重，但其实没什么大不了的。

sentences.en: He didn't want to talk much more about it but said he was sure he could get a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 他不想再多谈这事，只说他确信能谈妥认罪协议。

sentences.en: My mom and I stared at each other across the table.
sentences.zh: 我和妈妈隔着桌子对视着。

sentences.en: Something told us that, like his rum, this situation was not what he said it was.
sentences.zh: 直觉告诉我们，就像他的朗姆酒一样，这事并不像他说的那样。

sentences.en: I got into the back seat of the VW, my parents into the front.
sentences.zh: 我坐进大众汽车的后座，我父母坐在前座。

sentences.en: We drove north to San Francisco and then over the water and finally to the port of Crockett.
sentences.zh: 我们向北开往旧金山，然后跨过水面，最后到达克罗克特港。

sentences.en: Thirty days and I'll be back, he told us several times.
sentences.zh: “三十天后我就会回来，”他跟我们重复了好几次。

sentences.en: Fog was coming in over the docks like in one of those old movies.
sentences.zh: 雾像老电影里那样从码头漫了过来。

sentences.en: I love you, kid, he said.
sentences.zh: “我爱你，孩子，”他说。

sentences.en: He disappeared into the mist and then it broke for a moment and I could see his silhouette again walking toward the ship.
sentences.zh: 他消失在雾气中，接着雾气散开了一会儿，我又看到他的剪影正朝船走去。

sentences.en: I thought I could hear him humming something to himself.
sentences.zh: 我以为我能听到他自己哼着什么曲子。

sentences.en: Thirty days passed and the phone didn't ring.
sentences.zh: 三十天过去了，电话没有响。

sentences.en: It was a hot autumn in California and I kept on the hunt for wildlife in the creek.
sentences.zh: 那是加利福尼亚炎热的秋天，我一直在小溪里寻找野生动物。

sentences.en: While my mom was busy in the trailer crocheting the blankets she liked to make before the temperature started to drop.
sentences.zh: 而我妈则在拖车里忙着织她喜欢在气温下降前做好的毯子。

sentences.en: It had always been months between my father's visits, so when a year passed, we figured he had just gone back to sea after jail.
sentences.zh: 我父亲每次探望之间总是隔了好几个月，所以当一年过去后，我们以为他出狱后又回海上去工作了。

sentences.en: When two years passed, my mom revised the theory.
sentences.zh: 当两年过去后，我妈修正了她的推测。

sentences.en: He was still incarcerated, just for longer than he'd expected.
sentences.zh: 他还被关在里面，只是刑期比他预期的要长。

sentences.en: But my mom seemed determined that he would make his mark on my childhood whether he was with us or not.
sentences.zh: 但我妈似乎铁了心要让他在我的童年里留下印记，不管他在不在我们身边。

sentences.en: On one of his last visits, he asked to see where I was going to school.
sentences.zh: 在他最后几次来探望时，他要求去看看我上学的地方。

sentences.en: She brought down a class picture taken in front of the playground.
sentences.zh: 她拿出一张在操场前拍的班级合影。

sentences.en: There are no black kids in this photo except for Nicholas, he said and put the photo down.
sentences.zh: “这张照片里除了尼古拉斯，没有一个黑人孩子，”他说着把照片放了下来。

sentences.en: If you send him here, to this La-Di-Da school, he'll forget who he is and be afraid of his own people.
sentences.zh: “如果你把他送到这里，送到这所装腔作势的学校，他会忘本，并且会害怕自己的人民。”

sentences.en: My mother reminded him that she was the one who had chosen to raise me, while he spent his time in places like Papua New Guinea and Manila.
sentences.zh: 我母亲提醒他，当年是我选择把我抚养长大，而他却把时间花在巴布亚新几内亚和马尼拉那样的地方。

sentences.en: But another part of her thought he might be right.
sentences.zh: 但她内心深处的另一个想法是，他可能是对的。

sentences.en: While I'd been raised by a white woman and attended a white school, in the eyes of America, I would never be white.
sentences.zh: 虽然我是由一个白人女性抚养长大并上了一所白人学校，但在美国的眼里，我永远不会是白人。

sentences.en: That afternoon, his words seemed to have put a tiny crack in her motherly confidence.
sentences.zh: 那天下午，他的话似乎让这位母亲的自信心产生了一道细小的裂痕。

sentences.en: One day, not long after her sister died of a drug overdose, my mother announced she was taking me out of the school for good.
sentences.zh: 有一天，就在她姐姐因吸毒过量去世后不久，我母亲宣布让我彻底离开这所学校。

sentences.en: We approached my next school in the VW that day to find it flanked by a high, chain-link fence.
sentences.zh: 那天，我们坐着大众汽车来到我的下一所学校，发现它四周被高高的链式铁丝网包围着。

sentences.en: Like me, the students were black, and so were the teachers.
sentences.zh: 就像我一样，学生们是黑人，老师也是黑人。

sentences.en: But the school came with the harsh realities of what it meant to be black in America.
sentences.zh: 但这所学校伴随着作为美国黑人所必须面对的严酷现实。

sentences.en: It was in a district based in East Palo Alto, California, a town that made headlines across the country that year, 1992,
sentences.zh: 它位于加利福尼亚州东帕洛阿尔托的一个学区，该镇在1992年那个年份登上了全国各大报纸头条，

sentences.en: for having the highest per capita murder rate in the United States.
sentences.zh: 原因是其人均谋杀率全美最高。

sentences.en: A skinny fourth grader with a big grin came up to us and said his name was Princeton.
sentences.zh: 一个咧着大嘴笑的瘦高四年级男生向我们走来，说他叫普林斯顿。

sentences.en: Don't worry, we'll take care of him, he said.
sentences.zh: “别担心，我们会照顾他的，”他说。

sentences.en: My mom gave me a kiss and walked away.
sentences.zh: 我妈亲了我一下，然后走开了。

sentences.en: Many of the other students had missing fathers, ones they had long ago given up on finding.
sentences.zh: 许多其他学生都缺失父爱，那是他们早已放弃寻找的父亲。

sentences.en: It was my mother's presence that marked me as different from my classmates.
sentences.zh: 是我母亲的存在让我显得与同班同学不同。

sentences.en: One child, repeating a phrase she learned at home, told me my mother had jungle fever because she was one of the white ladies who liked black men.
sentences.zh: 一个孩子重复着她在家里听来的话，告诉我母亲得了“丛林热”，因为她是那种喜欢黑人男性的白人女性之一。

sentences.en: Why do you talk like a white boy, I was asked.
sentences.zh: “你为什么说话像个白人男孩？”有人这样问我。

sentences.en: These might seem like no more than skirmishes on a playground, but they felt like endless battles then,
sentences.zh: 这些在当时看来不过是操场上的小摩擦，但在那时却感觉像是一场场无休止的战斗，

sentences.en: and my constant retreats were determining the borders of who I was about to become.
sentences.zh: 而我不断的退缩正在划定我即将成为什么样的人的边界。

sentences.en: At the white school, I loved to play soccer and was a good athlete.
sentences.zh: 在白人学校里，我喜欢踢足球，而且是个出色的运动员。

sentences.en: But there were only basketball courts now and I didn't know how to shoot.
sentences.zh: 但现在只有篮球场了，而我不会投篮。

sentences.en: The few times I tried brought howls and once again I was told I was too white.
sentences.zh: 我有过几次尝试，结果引来一片嘘声，我又一次被告知我太白了。

sentences.en: I never played sports again in my life.
sentences.zh: 我这辈子再也没参加过体育运动。

sentences.en: Labeled a nerd, I withdrew into a world of books.
sentences.zh: 我被贴上了书呆子的标签，退缩进了书的世界里。

sentences.en: It certainly didn't help the day it came out that my middle name was Wimberley.
sentences.zh: 当我的中间名叫温伯利的事实曝光那天，情况并没有变得更好。

sentences.en: That's a stupid-ass name, said an older bully whose parents beat him.
sentences.zh: “那是一个蠢透了的名字，”一个父母经常虐待他的大个子恶霸说道。

sentences.en: Who the hell would call someone that?
sentences.zh: “到底谁会给别人取这种名字？”

sentences.en: Wimberley came from my father's family, and strange as the name might have been, my mother wanted me to have it as well.
sentences.zh: 温伯利来自我父亲的家族，不管这个名字有多奇怪，我母亲也希望我拥有它。

sentences.en: But where was he now?
sentences.zh: 但他现在在哪里？

sentences.en: He hadn't even written to us.
sentences.zh: 他甚至连信都没写给我们。

sentences.en: If he could come visit, just pick me up one day from school one afternoon.
sentences.zh: 如果他能来看看我，哪怕只是某个下午放学时顺便接我一次。

sentences.en: I thought, maybe the other kids could see that I was like them and not some imposter.
sentences.zh: 我想，也许其他孩子就能看出我和他们一样，而不是什么冒牌货。

sentences.en: One day when I was trying to pick up an astronomy book that had slipped out of my backpack, the bully banged my head against the tiles in a bathroom.
sentences.zh: 有一天，当我正试图捡起一本从背包里滑落的天文学书时，那个恶霸把我的头撞在洗手间的瓷砖上。

sentences.en: My mother got very quiet when I told her and asked me to point out who he was.
sentences.zh: 当我告诉母亲时，她变得非常安静，并让我指出他是谁。

sentences.en: The next day she found him next to a drinking fountain, pulled him into a secluded corner, and told him if he touched me again,
sentences.zh: 第二天，她在饮水机旁找到了他，把他拉到一个僻静的角落，告诉他如果他再敢碰我，

sentences.en: she would find him again and beat him when no one was looking.
sentences.zh: 她会在没人的时候再次找到他并痛打他一顿。

sentences.en: So there would be no bruises, and no adult would believe she'd touched him.
sentences.zh: 这样就不会留下淤青，也没有成年人会相信她碰过他。

sentences.en: From then on, the bully left me alone.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，那个恶霸再也没找过我的麻烦。

sentences.en: But the image of a white woman threatening a black child who didn't belong to her wasn't lost on anyone, not least my classmates, who now kept their distance too.
sentences.zh: 但是，一个白人女性威胁一个不属于她的黑人孩子的画面并没有被任何人忽视，尤其是我的同学们，他们现在也和我保持着距离。

sentences.en: A Catholic nun who ran a program at the school saw that things weren't working.
sentences.zh: 学校里负责一个项目的修女看到情况不对劲。

sentences.en: I had spent so much time alone reading the math and history textbooks from the grade above me that the school made me skip a year.
sentences.zh: 我花了太多时间独自阅读高一个年级的数学和历史课本，以至于学校让我跳了一级。

sentences.en: Now the teachers were talking about having me skip another grade, which would put me in high school.
sentences.zh: 现在老师们正在讨论让我再跳一级，那样我就要读高中了。

sentences.en: I was just 12.
sentences.zh: 我当时只有12岁。

sentences.en: Sister Georgie had a different solution.
sentences.zh: 乔治修女有一个不同的解决方案。

sentences.en: A private school named Menlo, where she thought I would be able to get a scholarship.
sentences.zh: 一所名叫门洛的私立学校，她认为我在那里能争取到奖学金。

sentences.en: She warned that it might be hard to fit in, and from the sound of things, the school would be even whiter and wealthier than the one my mother had taken me from.
sentences.zh: 她警告说我可能很难融入，从情况来看，这所学校甚至会比我母亲带我离开的那所更加白人化、更加富有。

sentences.en: But I didn't care.
sentences.zh: 但我不在乎。

sentences.en: At that point, I couldn't imagine much worse than this failed experiment to teach me what it meant to be black.
sentences.zh: 在那时，我无法想象还有什么比这场教导我身为黑人意味着什么的失败实验更糟糕的了。

sentences.en: It had been five years since my father's departure.
sentences.zh: 距离我父亲离开已经过去五年了。

sentences.en: In the mid-1990s, California had passed a three-strikes law, which swept up people across the state with life sentences for a third felony conviction.
sentences.zh: 在20世纪90年代中期，加利福尼亚州通过了一项“三振出局”法案，该法案对全州因第三次重罪定居而被捕的人判处无期徒刑。

sentences.en: My mom, who had retrained in computerized accounting, started using her free time to search for his name in prison databases.
sentences.zh: 我母亲重新接受了计算机化会计的培训，她开始利用空闲时间在监狱数据库里搜索他的名字。

sentences.en: It was the first time I saw her refer to him by a full name,
sentences.zh: 这是我第一次看到她用全名称呼他，

sentences.en: Nicholas Wimberly Ortega.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯·温伯利·奥特加。
zh_words: 尼古拉斯·温伯利·奥特加

sentences.en: Ortega, I knew, was a Hispanic name.
sentences.zh: 我知道，奥特加是一个西班牙语名字。

sentences.en: I usually saw it on TV ads where it was emblazoned on a brand of Mexican salsa.
sentences.zh: 我通常在电视广告上看到它，它醒目地印在一个墨西哥莎莎酱的品牌上。

sentences.en: It seemed to have little to do with me, but my mother had also dropped hints that I might be Latino.
sentences.zh: 这似乎和我没什么关系，但我母亲也曾暗示过我可能有拉丁血统。

sentences.en: She called me Nico, for short, and had taken to the surprise of the Mexican family in the trailer next to us to also calling me Mijo, the Spanish contraction of my son.
sentences.zh: 她叫我尼科作为昵称，并且——令我们隔壁拖车里的墨西哥家庭感到惊讶的是——还开始叫我米霍，也就是“我儿子”的西班牙语缩写。

sentences.en: One day I asked her about it.
sentences.zh: 有一天我向她问起这事。

sentences.en: She explained that she missed her days in Puerto Rico when she was in her 30s.
sentences.zh: 她解释说她很怀念30多岁时在波多黎各的日子。

sentences.en: But there was also my father's family, which she remembered him telling her came to the United States from Cuba.
sentences.zh: 但还有我父亲的家族，她记得他说过他们是从古巴来到美国的。

sentences.en: In Cuba, she said, you could be both Latino and black.
sentences.zh: 她说，在古巴，你既可以是拉丁裔也可以是黑人。

sentences.en: Menlo School became my first intellectual refuge, where I was suddenly reading Shakespeare and carrying a viola to school that I was learning to play.
sentences.zh: 门洛学校成了我的第一个精神避难所，我在那里突然开始阅读莎士比亚，还背着一把正在学习演奏的中提琴去学校。

sentences.en: Four foreign languages were on offer, but there was no question which one I would take.
sentences.zh: 学校开设了四门外语，但我毫不犹豫地知道自己该选哪一门。

sentences.en: I signed up for Spanish my freshman year, based on the revelation about my father's background.
sentences.zh: 根据关于我父亲背景的新发现，我在高一注册了西班牙语。

sentences.en: We spent afternoons in class captivated by unwieldy irregular verbs like tener, to have, or how the language considered every object in the universe either masculine or feminine.
sentences.zh: 我们在课堂上花了一整个下午，被那些难驾驭的不规则动词（如tener，意为“拥有”）所吸引，或者研究这门语言是如何将宇宙中的每一个对象都视为阳性或阴性的。

sentences.en: A friend introduced me to the poems of Pablo Neruda.
sentences.zh: 一个朋友向我介绍了巴勃罗·聂鲁达的诗歌。

sentences.en: One day, a rumor started to spread on campus that the Menlo Chorus had received permission to fly to Cuba to sing a series of concerts that spring.
sentences.zh: 有一天，校园里开始流传一个谣言：门洛合唱团已经获得批准，将于那个春天飞往古巴进行一系列音乐会演出。

sentences.en: Not long afterward, the choral director, Mrs. Jordan, called me into her office.
sentences.zh: 不久之后，合唱团指挥约旦太太把我叫进了她的办公室。

sentences.en: I'd taken her music theory class and had been learning to write chamber music with her and a small group of students.
sentences.zh: 我上过她的音乐理论课，并一直在和她以及一小群学生学习创作室内乐。

sentences.en: At recitals that year, she helped record some of the pieces I composed.
sentences.zh: 在那年的独奏音乐会上，她帮忙录制了我创作的一些曲子。

sentences.en: I thought her summons had to do with that.
sentences.zh: 我以为她传唤我是为了那件事。

sentences.en: Are you a tenor, she asked.
sentences.zh: “你是男高音吗？”她问。

sentences.en: I told her I couldn't sing.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她我不会唱歌。

sentences.en: Everyone could sing, she said.
sentences.zh: 她说每个人都会唱歌。

sentences.en: There was a pause.
sentences.zh: 一阵沉默。

sentences.en: I thought only my closest friends knew anything about my father.
sentences.zh: 我以为只有我最亲密的朋友才知道我父亲的事。

sentences.en: Everyone's family at this school seemed close to perfect, so I rarely mentioned mine.
sentences.zh: 这所学校里每个人的家庭看起来都近乎完美，所以我很少提及我的家人。

sentences.en: Mrs. Jordan looked up.
sentences.zh: 约旦太太抬起头来。

sentences.en: She noted that I had Cuban ancestry and spoke Spanish.
sentences.zh: 她指出我有古巴血统并且会说西班牙语。

sentences.en: I deserved to go on the trip.
sentences.zh: 我有资格去参加这次旅行。

sentences.en: With the United States embargo against Cuba still in effect, who knew when I might get another chance?
sentences.zh: 鉴于美国对古巴的禁运仍然有效，谁知道我什么时候才能有下一次机会呢？

sentences.en: And you don't need to worry about the cost of the trip, she said.
sentences.zh: “而且你不用担心旅行的费用，”她说。

sentences.en: You can be our translator.
sentences.zh: “你可以担任我们的翻译。”

sentences.en: We traveled from Havana to the Bay of Pigs and then to Trinidad, an old colonial town at the foot of a mountain range with cobblestones and a bell tower.
sentences.zh: 我们从哈瓦那出发，去了猪湾，然后前往特立尼达，那是一座位于山脉脚下的古老殖民小镇，有着鹅卵石街道和一座钟楼。

sentences.en: I sat in the front of a bus humming along to a CD of Beethoven string quartets that I had brought and watching the landscape fly by, while the chorus rehearsed in the back.
sentences.zh: 我坐在大巴的前排，跟着我带来的一张贝多芬弦乐四重奏CD轻声哼唱，看着窗外的风景飞驰而过，而合唱团则在后排排练。

sentences.en: My Spanish was halting in those days, just words and phrases stitched together out of a textbook, and the Cuban accent could just as well have been French to me then.
sentences.zh: 那时的我的西班牙语还很结巴，只是从教科书里拼凑出来的字词和短语，当时的古巴口音对我和法语也没什么两样。

sentences.en: But the crowds that the chorus sang for roared when they found out that one of the Americans would be introducing the group in Spanish.
sentences.zh: 但是，当合唱团得知其中一位美国人将用西班牙语为合唱团做介绍时，台下合唱团为之献唱的观众们爆发出雷鸣般的掌声。

sentences.en: The concert hall in the city of Cienfuegos was packed with Cubans and humid air.
sentences.zh: 西恩富戈斯市的音乐厅里挤满了古巴人和潮湿的空气。

sentences.en: I stepped out and greeted everyone.
sentences.zh: 我走上台去向大家问好。

sentences.en: He is one of us, yelled someone in Spanish.
sentences.zh: “他是我们自己人，”有人用西班牙语大喊。

sentences.en: Just look at this boy.
sentences.zh: “看看这孩子。”

sentences.en: In the days after I returned home, it began to hit me just how much I had lost with the disappearance of my father.
sentences.zh: 在我回家的几天后，我开始意识到随着父亲的消失，我失去了多少东西。

sentences.en: On the streets of Havana, there were men as black as my father, teenagers with the same light brown skin as me.
sentences.zh: 在哈瓦那的街头，有和我父亲一样黑的男人，有和我有着同样浅棕色皮肤的青少年。

sentences.en: They could be distant relatives for all I knew.
sentences.zh: 据我所知，他们可能是远亲。

sentences.en: Yet with no trace of my father besides a last name, I would never be able to tell them apart from any other stranger in the Caribbean.
sentences.zh: 然而，除了一个姓氏之外，找不到我父亲的任何踪迹，我将永远无法将他们与加勒比海地区的任何其他陌生人区分开来。

sentences.en: My mother said my father had once looked for a birthmark on me that all his children had.
sentences.zh: 我母亲说我父亲曾经在我身上寻找一个他所有孩子都有的胎记。

sentences.en: So where were these siblings?
sentences.zh: 那么这些兄弟姐妹在哪里呢？

sentences.en: How old were they now?
sentences.zh: 他们现在多大了？

sentences.en: How old is my father even, I asked.
sentences.zh: 我甚至问过，我父亲现在多大了？

sentences.en: My mother said she wasn't sure.
sentences.zh: 我母亲说她不确定。

sentences.en: He was older than she was.
sentences.zh: 他比她年长。

sentences.en: How had she been searching for this man in prison records without a birth date?
sentences.zh: 在没有出生日期的情况下，她是怎么在监狱记录里搜寻这个男人的？

sentences.en: I pushed for more details.
sentences.zh: 我追问更多的细节。

sentences.en: But the childhood wonder of the days when I would hear about his adventures had drained off long ago.
sentences.zh: 但当年那些听到他的冒险经历时的童年惊奇早已消磨殆尽。

sentences.en: I was 16.
sentences.zh: 我16岁了。

sentences.en: And the man had now been gone for half my life.
sentences.zh: 而这个男人现在已经离开了我生命的一半时间。

sentences.en: My mother tried her best to tell me the things she remembered his mentioning about himself during his visits.
sentences.zh: 我母亲尽最大努力把她记得的他在探望期间提到过自己的事情告诉我。

sentences.en: It all seemed to pour out at once, hurried and unreliable.
sentences.zh: 这一切似乎一下子倾泻而出，仓促而又不可靠。

sentences.en: And it was no help that the details that she recalled first were the ones that were the hardest to believe.
sentences.zh: 她最先回忆起的那些细节偏偏又是最让人难以置信的，这毫无帮助。

sentences.en: He grew up somewhere in Arizona, she said, But was raised on Navajo land.
sentences.zh: 她说，他在亚利桑那州的某个地方长大，但却是在纳瓦霍人的土地上抚养长大的。

sentences.en: He got mixed up with a gang.
sentences.zh: 他跟一个黑帮混在了一起。

sentences.en: I had heard many of these stories before, and I accepted them mostly on faith.
sentences.zh: 这些故事我以前听过很多次，我基本上是深信不疑。

sentences.en: But now I thought I could distinguish fact from fiction.
sentences.zh: 但现在我认为自己能够分清事实与虚构了。

sentences.en: And the facts were that he had gone missing, and my mother had no answers.
sentences.zh: 事实是，他失踪了，而我母亲没有任何答案。

sentences.en: Was I the only one who didn't take this casually?
sentences.zh: 难道只有我一个人没有把这当成无所谓的事吗？

sentences.en: My mother started to say something else, and I stopped her.
sentences.zh: 我母亲刚想说点别的，我打断了她。

sentences.en: Do you even know his name?
sentences.zh: “你甚至知道他的名字吗？”

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.zh: 我问。

sentences.en: Nicholas Wimberly Ortega.
sentences.zh: “尼古拉斯·温伯利·奥特加。”
zh_words: 尼古拉斯·温伯利·奥特加

sentences.en: She was almost crying.
sentences.zh: 她几乎要哭了。

sentences.en: Wimberly, I said, pronouncing the name slow and angry.
sentences.zh: “温伯利，”我说，语气缓慢而愤怒地念出这个名字。

sentences.en: I wonder if it even is.
sentences.zh: 我甚至怀疑到底有没有这个人。

sentences.en: I've never known someone who had a name that ridiculous other than me.
sentences.zh: 除了我自己，我从未见过谁的名字这么荒谬。

sentences.en: I know it wasn't fair to take out my anger on the woman who raised me and not the man who disappeared.
sentences.zh: 我知道把怒气发泄在抚养我长大的母亲身上，而不是那个消失的男人，这很不公平。

sentences.en: But soon a kind of chance came to confront my father too.
sentences.zh: 但不久之后，命运也给了一次与我父亲对质的机会。

sentences.en: His life at sea rarely crossed my thoughts anymore, but by the time I was in college, sailing had entered into my own life in a different way.
sentences.zh: 他在海上的生活早已很少占据我的脑海，但到了上大学的时候，航海以另一种方式进入了我自己的生活。

sentences.en: My third year at Stanford, I attended a lecture by an anthropologist on Polynesian wayfinding.
sentences.zh: 我在斯坦福读大三时，听了一场人类学家关于波利尼西亚人航海定位的讲座。

sentences.en: Nearly every island in the Pacific, the professor explained, had been discovered without the use of compasses by men in canoes who navigated by the stars.
sentences.zh: 教授解释说，太平洋上的几乎每个岛屿，都是没有指南针的情况下，由乘独木舟凭星星导航的人发现的。

sentences.en: The professor put up an image of the hokulea, a modern canoe modeled off the ancient ones.
sentences.zh: 教授展示了一张“霍库莱阿”号的图片，这是一艘仿造古代独木舟制造的现代独木舟。

sentences.en: He said there were still Polynesians who knew the ancient ways.
sentences.zh: 他说，依然有波利尼西亚人懂得古代的航海方法。

sentences.en: Within months of the lecture, I read everything I could find about them.
sentences.zh: 讲座结束后没几个月，我阅读了所有能找到的关于他们的资料。

sentences.en: The search led me to major in anthropology and then to the Pacific, to Guam, and to a group of islands called Yap, where I had a research grant.
sentences.zh: 这次寻找促使我主修了人类学，随后我来到了太平洋，去了关岛，还有一个叫雅浦的群岛，我在那里拿到了研究资助。

sentences.en: I was working on an honors thesis about living navigators.
sentences.zh: 我当时在写一篇关于在世导航员的荣誉学位论文。

sentences.en: The men used wooden canoes without riggers for their journeys and traded large stone coins as money.
sentences.zh: 这些人航行时使用的是没有平衡浮木的木质独木舟，并用巨大的石币作为货币进行交易。

sentences.en: But their jokes and drinking reminded me instantly of my father.
sentences.zh: 但他们开的玩笑和酗酒的样子瞬间让我想起了我父亲。

sentences.en: One night after I was back from the research trip, I fell asleep in my college dorm room, which I shared with two other roommates.
sentences.zh: 结束研究之旅回到学校后的一个晚上，我在大学宿舍里睡着了，我和另外两个室友合住这间宿舍。

sentences.en: I almost never saw my father in dreams, but I'd vowed that the next time I did, I would tell him off right there in the dream.
sentences.zh: 我几乎从来不在梦里见到父亲，但我曾发誓，下次再梦到他时，一定要当面数落他。

sentences.en: And there he was suddenly that night.
sentences.zh: 那天夜里，他突然就出现在那里。

sentences.en: I don't remember what I said to him, but I woke up shaken.
sentences.zh: 我不记得对他说过什么了，但我醒来时心有余悸。

sentences.en: I remember he had no face.
sentences.zh: 我记得他没有脸。

sentences.en: I wasn't able to recall it after all these years.
sentences.zh: 这么多年过去了，我怎么也想不起他的样子。

sentences.en: I was yelling at a faceless man.
sentences.zh: 我当时正在对一个没有脸的男人大吼大叫。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 纽约时报应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 众所周知，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你可以免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在该应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你尚未订阅《纽约时报》，请立即下载《时报》应用，即可免费畅读30天。

sentences.en: When I graduated, I decided to work as a reporter.
sentences.zh: 毕业后，我决定当一名记者。

sentences.en: I'm not sure it was a choice my mother saw coming.
sentences.zh: 我不确定母亲是否预料到了这个选择。

sentences.en: The only newspapers I remember seeing as a child were Sunday editions of the San Francisco Chronicle, which she bought for the TV listings and to harvest coupons.
sentences.zh: 据我记忆，我小时候见过的唯一报纸就是《旧金山纪事报》的周日版，那是她为了看电视节目表和收集优惠券买的。

sentences.en: The newspapers had international pages and foreign correspondents who wrote for them.
sentences.zh: 这些报纸有国际版面，并配有为它们撰稿的外国通讯员。

sentences.en: It seemed like a way to start knowing the world.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是开始了解世界的一种方式。

sentences.en: She understood that I needed to leave.
sentences.zh: 她明白我必须离开。

sentences.en: But she also knew that it meant she would no longer just be waiting by the phone to hear my father's voice on the other end of the line.
sentences.zh: 但她也知道，这意味着她将不再只是守在电话旁，等待听见电话那头我父亲的声音。

sentences.en: She would now be waiting to hear mine.
sentences.zh: 她现在得等着听我的声音了。

sentences.en: I was hired by the Wall Street Journal when I was 23.
sentences.zh: 我23岁时被《华尔街日报》录用。

sentences.en: And two years later, I was sent to the Mexico City office.
sentences.zh: 两年后，我被派往墨西哥城分社。

sentences.en: By that point, Latin America wasn't just the place that spoke my second language.
sentences.zh: 到那时，拉丁美洲不仅仅是一个说我第二语言的地方。

sentences.en: After classical music, the region was becoming an obsession for me.
sentences.zh: 继古典音乐之后，这个地区正成为我的一种着迷所在。

sentences.en: The Caribbean was part of the Bureau's purview, and I took whatever excuse I could to work there.
sentences.zh: 加勒比海属于分社的管辖范围，我抓住一切借口去那里工作。

sentences.en: It was at the Mexico Bureau that I also got to know a Cuban-American for the first time.
sentences.zh: 正是在墨西哥分社，我第一次结识了一位古巴裔美国人。

sentences.en: A veteran reporter named José de Córdoba, whose desk sat opposite mine in the attic where our offices were.
sentences.zh: 一位名叫何塞·德科尔多瓦的资深记者，我们的办公室设在阁楼，他的办公桌正对着我的。

sentences.en: De Córdoba was a legend at the paper, a kind of Latino Graham Greene, who grew up on the streets of New York.
sentences.zh: 德科尔多瓦是报社的传奇人物，有点像成长于纽约街头的拉丁裔格雷厄姆·格林。

sentences.en: As a child, he fled Cuba with his family after the revolution.
sentences.zh: 小时候，他在革命后随家人逃离了古巴。

sentences.en: I had only a single name that connected me to the island, but that didn't seem to matter to him or to anyone else for that matter.
sentences.zh: 我只有一个与这个岛屿相连的名字，但这对他或其他人来说似乎并不重要。

sentences.en: In the United States, where your identity was always in your skin, I had never fully fit in as a white or a black man.
sentences.zh: 在美国，身份总是写在你的皮肤上，我从来没有作为白人或黑人完全融入过。

sentences.en: But here, I was starting to feel at home.
sentences.zh: 但在这里，我开始感到宾至如归。

sentences.en: I had always struggled to tell my own story to others, embarrassed by the poverty or the absent dad or the fact that none of it seemed to have a through line or conclusion.
sentences.zh: 我一直很难向别人讲述自己的故事，因为贫困、缺席的父亲，或者这一切似乎都没有主线或结局而感到尴尬。

sentences.en: Telling the stories of others came more easily.
sentences.zh: 讲述别人的故事则要容易得多。

sentences.en: I loved the rainy season when the thunderclouds would pile up above Mexico City and pour down in the afternoons, washing the capital clean.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢雨季，那时雷雨云在墨西哥城上空堆积，在午后倾泻而下，将首都冲刷得干干净净。

sentences.en: I sat in the attic, trying to condense someone's life into a newspaper profile.
sentences.zh: 我坐在阁楼里，试图将某人的一生浓缩为一篇报纸人物专访。

sentences.en: De Córdoba would be working on his Fidel Castro obituary, a labor of love he had first drafted in the 1990s, filling it with every manner of anecdote over the years.
sentences.zh: 德科尔多瓦则在撰写菲德尔·卡斯特罗的讣告，这是他自20世纪90年代以来就开始倾注心血的工作，多年来在其中填充了各种各样的轶事。

sentences.en: I hung a big National Geographic map of the Caribbean above my desk and looked up at it, Cuba near the center.
sentences.zh: 我在办公桌上方挂了一张巨大的《国家地理》加勒比海地图并抬头看着它，古巴位于中心附近。

sentences.en: The mapmaker hadn't just marked bays and capital cities, but also some of the events that had taken place in the sea,
sentences.zh: 地图绘制者不仅标注了海湾和首都，还标注了海面上发生过的一些事件，

sentences.en: like where the Apollo 9 capsule had splashed down and where Columbus had sighted land.
sentences.zh: 比如阿波罗9号飞船溅落的地点以及哥伦布发现陆地的地点。

sentences.en: I liked that.
sentences.zh: 我喜欢这样。

sentences.en: The romantic in me wanted to see that poster as a map of the events of my own life, too.
sentences.zh: 我心中的浪漫主义者也想把那张海报看作是我自己人生经历的地图。

sentences.en: There was Haiti, where I covered an earthquake that leveled much of the country,
sentences.zh: 那里有海地，我在那里报道了一场夷平了该国大部分地区的地震；

sentences.en: and Jamaica, where I saw the government lay siege on a part of Kingston while trying to capture a drug boss.
sentences.zh: 还有牙买加，我在那里目睹了政府在试图抓捕一名大毒枭时对金斯敦某一部分实施的围剿。

sentences.en: On Vieques, a Puerto Rican island, I spent a long afternoon in the waves with three friends sharing a warm bottle of rum.
sentences.zh: 在波多黎各的一个小岛别克斯岛，我和三个朋友在海浪中度过了一个漫长的下午，分喝了一瓶温朗姆酒。

sentences.en: The rum reminded me of my father.
sentences.zh: 这朗姆酒让我想起了父亲。

sentences.en: The beach was near where my mother tended bar in the years before she met him.
sentences.zh: 海滩就在我母亲遇到他之前几年经营酒吧的地方附近。

sentences.en: During my visit, I called her up half drunk to tell her where I was.
sentences.zh: 我访问期间，半醉半醒地给她打电话，告诉她我在哪里。

sentences.en: There was barely enough signal for a cell phone call, and it cut off several times, but I could hear a nostalgia welling up in her for that part of her youth.
sentences.zh: 手机信号微弱，断了好几次，但我能听到她对那段青春岁月的怀旧之情涌上心头。

sentences.en: It was all of a sudden decades away now.
sentences.zh: 现在这一切突然已经是几十年前的事了。

sentences.en: She was nearly 70, and both of us recognized the time that had passed.
sentences.zh: 她快七十岁了，我们俩都意识到时光的流逝。

sentences.en: By the time my stint in Mexico was up, I had saved enough money to buy my mother a house.
sentences.zh: 我在墨西哥的任期结束时，已经存够了钱给母亲买栋房子。

sentences.en: We both knew she couldn't spend the rest of her life in the trailer.
sentences.zh: 我们俩都知道她不能在活动房屋里度过余生。

sentences.en: My grandmother died the year before.
sentences.zh: 我外祖母在前一年去世了。

sentences.en: The only family either of us had left were two nieces and a nephew that my mother had largely lost touch with after her sister died.
sentences.zh: 我们俩仅剩的亲人是两个侄女和一个外甥，母亲在她姐姐去世后就和他们基本失联了。

sentences.en: We found a place for sale near the town where my cousins lived in the Sierra Nevada foothills.
sentences.zh: 我们在内华达山脉山麓的表亲们居住的小镇附近找到了一处待售房产。

sentences.en: It was a green and white home with three bedrooms and a wraparound porch, and the owner said it was built after the gold rush.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋绿白相间的房子，有三间卧室和一条环形门廊，房主说它是淘金热之后建造的。

sentences.en: Part of me wished that up there in the mountains my mother and cousins might find some kind of family life that I'd never known.
sentences.zh: 我内心里有一部分希望，母亲和表亲们能在群山之巅找到我从未体验过的某种家庭生活。

sentences.en: We sold the trailer for $16,000 to a family of four who had been living in a van across the street from her.
sentences.zh: 我们以16,000美元的价格将活动房屋卖给了一家四口，他们一直住在她街对面的货车里。

sentences.en: We packed her life's possessions into a U-Haul and headed across the bay and toward the mountains.
sentences.zh: 我们把她一生的家当装进一辆U-Haul货车，朝着海湾对面、大山方向驶去。

sentences.en: Our telephone number had always been the same.
sentences.zh: 我们的电话号码一直没变。

sentences.en: We had always lived in the same mobile home park alongside the same highway at the same slot behind the creek, number 35.
sentences.zh: 我们一直住在同一条高速公路旁、同一片流动房屋公园里，在小溪后方的同一个车位，35号。

sentences.en: We had waited there for 20 years.
sentences.zh: 我们在那里等了20年。

sentences.en: You know, if he comes, he won't know where to find us anymore, she said.
sentences.zh: “你知道，如果他来了，就再也找不到我们了，”她说。

sentences.en: By the time I was in my 30s, I was the Andes bureau chief for the New York Times covering a wide swath of South America.
sentences.zh: 三十多岁时，我是《纽约时报》安第斯分社社长，负责报道南美洲的广阔地域。

sentences.en: One March, I traveled to a guerrilla camp in the Colombian jungle to interview a group of rebels waging war against the government.
sentences.zh: 三月的一天，我前往哥伦比亚丛林中的一个游击队营地，采访了一群与政府交战的叛军。

sentences.en: It was a hot, dry day.
sentences.zh: 那是一个炎热干燥的日子。

sentences.en: Some fighters in fatigues had slaughtered a cow and were butchering it for lunch.
sentences.zh: 一些穿着迷彩服的武装人员宰了一头牛，正在为午餐切肉。

sentences.en: Teofilo Panclasta, one of the older guerrillas, had been talking to me for about an hour.
sentences.zh: 特奥菲洛·潘克拉斯塔，年纪较大的游击队员之一，跟我交谈了一个多小时。

sentences.en: But it wasn't until I told him that my father was Cuban that his eyes lit up.
sentences.zh: 直到我告诉他我父亲是古巴人时，他的眼睛才亮了起来。

sentences.en: He pointed to the red star in his beret and tried to recall a song from the Cuban revolution.
sentences.zh: 他指着贝雷帽上的红星，试图回忆起一首古巴革命歌曲。

sentences.en: Where is your father now?
sentences.zh: “你父亲现在在哪里？”

sentences.en: Panclasta asked.
sentences.zh: 潘克拉斯塔问。

sentences.en: The answer surprised me when I said it.
sentences.zh: 当我回答时，这个答案让我自己也很意外。

sentences.en: I'm almost sure that he's dead.
sentences.zh: “我几乎可以肯定他已经死了。”

sentences.en: I knew my father was older than my mother, maybe a decade older.
sentences.zh: 我知道父亲比母亲年纪大，大概大十岁左右。

sentences.en: But I'd never actually said what I assumed to be true for many years.
sentences.zh: 但我从来没有真正说出我多年来一直认为理所当然的事情。

sentences.en: I figured no man could have made it through the prison system to that age.
sentences.zh: 我想象不出有哪个男人能在监狱系统中活到那个年纪。

sentences.en: And if he had made it out of there, he would have tracked us down years ago.
sentences.zh: 如果他真的从那里逃出来了，多年前就会找到我们了。

sentences.en: The realization he was not coming back left my relationship with my mother strained, even as she started her new life.
sentences.zh: 意识到他不会回来，使得我和母亲的关系变得紧张，尽管她已经开始了新生活。

sentences.en: I watched as friends posted pictures of new nieces and nephews.
sentences.zh: 我看着朋友们发布新侄子侄女的照片。

sentences.en: They went to family reunions.
sentences.zh: 他们去参加家庭聚会。

sentences.en: It seemed as if my mother didn't understand why these things upset me.
sentences.zh: 母亲似乎不理解为什么这些事情会让我难过。

sentences.en: She would just sit there knitting.
sentences.zh: 她只会坐在那里织毛衣。

sentences.en: A large part of me blamed her for my father's absence and felt it was she who needed to bring him back.
sentences.zh: 我很大一部分原因是在怪罪父亲的缺席，并觉得是她需要把他带回来。

sentences.en: On my 33rd birthday, the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 在我33岁生日那天，电话响了。

sentences.en: It was my mother, wishing me a happy birthday.
sentences.zh: 是我母亲打来的，祝我生日快乐。

sentences.en: She'd thought about my gift and decided on an ancestry test and was sending one to my address in Columbia.
sentences.zh: 她想过送我什么礼物，最后决定做一个祖源测试，并正把测试盒寄到我在哥伦比亚的地址。

sentences.en: She was sorry she didn't know more about what happened to my father.
sentences.zh: 她很遗憾自己对父亲的遭遇了解不多。

sentences.en: But this would at least give me some information about who I was.
sentences.zh: 但这至少能给我提供一些关于我是谁的信息。

sentences.en: The test sat on my desk for a while.
sentences.zh: 这个测试盒在我的桌上放了一段时间。

sentences.en: I wasn't sure that a report saying I was half black and half white was going to tell me anything I didn't already know.
sentences.zh: 我不确定一份说我有一半黑人血统、一半白人血统的报告能告诉我什么我不知道的事情。

sentences.en: But my mom kept calling me, asking if I'd sent my jeans off to the Mormons yet.
sentences.zh: 但我妈妈一直打电话问我有没有把牛仔裤寄给摩门教徒。

sentences.en: The company is based in Lehigh, Utah.
sentences.zh: 该公司总部位于犹他州利海。

sentences.en: And finally I relented, swabbing my mouth and sent the plastic test tube on its way.
sentences.zh: 最后我妥协了，用棉签擦拭了口腔，把塑料试管寄了出去。

sentences.en: The map that came back had no surprises.
sentences.zh: 寄回的地图没有任何惊喜。

sentences.en: There were pinpricks across Europe where possible great-great-grandmothers might have been born.
sentences.zh: 欧洲各地散落着一些图钉，标记着潜在的高曾祖母可能出生的地方。

sentences.en: West Africa was part of my ancestry too.
sentences.zh: 西非也是我血统的一部分。

sentences.en: The surprise was the section below the map.
sentences.zh: 惊喜在于地图下方的那部分。

sentences.en: At the bottom of the screen, the page listed one potential relative.
sentences.zh: 在屏幕底部，页面列出了一位潜在的亲戚。

sentences.en: It was a woman named Kinra who was in her 30s.
sentences.zh: 那是一位三十多岁、名叫金拉的女性。

sentences.en: The only family I had ever known was white, all from my mother's side.
sentences.zh: 我所知道的唯一的家庭都是白人，全在我母亲那边。

sentences.en: But Kinra, I could see from her picture, was black.
sentences.zh: 但从照片上看，金拉是黑人。

sentences.en: I clicked, and the screen popped up for me to write a message.
sentences.zh: 我点击进去，弹出了一个让我写留言的屏幕。

sentences.en: I didn't need to think about what to say to this person.
sentences.zh: 我不需要考虑对这个人说些什么。

sentences.en: I told her that my father had been gone for most of my life and I had mostly given up on ever finding him.
sentences.zh: 我告诉她，我父亲在我生命的大部分时间里都不在身边，我也基本上放弃了找到他的希望。

sentences.en: But this test said we were related.
sentences.zh: 但这个测试说我们有亲缘关系。

sentences.en: And she looked like she might be from his side of the family.
sentences.zh: 而且看起来她可能是他那边的亲戚。

sentences.en: I didn't know if he was alive anymore, I wrote.
sentences.zh: 我写道，我不知道他还活没活着。

sentences.en: He used to be a sailor.
sentences.zh: 他曾经是个水手。

sentences.en: I was sorry to have bothered her.
sentences.zh: 我很抱歉打扰了她。

sentences.en: I knew it was a long shot.
sentences.zh: 我知道希望渺茫。

sentences.en: But the test said she might be my cousin.
sentences.zh: 但测试说她可能是我的表妹。

sentences.en: And if she wanted to write, here was my email address.
sentences.zh: 如果她想回信，这是我的电子邮箱地址。

sentences.en: I hit send.
sentences.zh: 我点击了发送。

sentences.en: A message arrived.
sentences.zh: 一条消息发了过来。

sentences.en: Do you know your dad's name at all?
sentences.zh: “你知不知道你爸爸的名字？”

sentences.en: She wrote.
sentences.zh: 她写道。

sentences.en: My dad is a Wimberly.
sentences.zh: “我爸爸姓温伯利（Wimberly）。”

sentences.en: It wasn't spelled the same as we spelled it, but there was no mistaking that name.
sentences.zh: 它的拼写和我们的不太一样，但那个名字绝对错不了。

sentences.en: Kinra told me to wait.
sentences.zh: 金拉让我等等。

sentences.en: She wanted to look into things and write back when she knew more.
sentences.zh: 她想查一下情况，等了解更多后再回信。

sentences.en: Then came another message.
sentences.zh: 接着又来了一条消息。

sentences.en: Okay, so after reading your email and doing simple math,
sentences.zh: “好吧，在读了你的邮件并做了简单的算术之后，

sentences.en: I'd assume you are the uncle I was told about, she wrote.
sentences.zh: 我猜你就是他们跟我提起过的那个叔叔，”她写道。

sentences.en: I was someone's uncle.
sentences.zh: 我是某人的叔叔。

sentences.en: Nick Wimberly.
sentences.zh: 尼克·温伯利。

sentences.en: I stopped reading at the sight of my father's name.
sentences.zh: 一看到父亲的名字，我就停止了阅读。

sentences.en: A few seconds went by.
sentences.zh: 几秒钟过去了。

sentences.en: Nick Wimberly is my grandfather.
sentences.zh: “尼克·温伯利是我的祖父。

sentences.en: Papo, as we call him, she wrote.
sentences.zh: 我们都叫他帕波（Papo），”她写道。

sentences.en: My dad, Chris, has one full brother, Rod, and one full sister, Terry.
sentences.zh: “我爸爸克里斯有一个亲哥哥罗德，还有一个亲姐姐特里。”

sentences.en: Nick is pretty old, late 70s to early 80s.
sentences.zh: 尼克年纪挺大了，大概七十年代末到八十年代初。

sentences.en: Do you know if he would be that old?
sentences.zh: 你知道他会不会有那么老吗？

sentences.en: Earlier this year, I saw Papo, Nick, and he said he planned on moving to Guam by the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 今年早些时候，我见到了帕波和尼克，他说他计划在年底前搬去关岛。

sentences.en: My father was alive.
sentences.zh: 我父亲还活着。

sentences.en: Kinra wrote that if I wanted, she would send a few text messages and see if she could get me in touch with him.
sentences.zh: 金拉写信说，如果我愿意，她可以发几条短信，看能不能帮我和他取得联系。

sentences.en: The battery was running out on the laptop, and I went stumbling around the house looking for a cord, then sat on the couch.
sentences.zh: 笔记本电脑快没电了，我在屋里跌跌撞撞地找充电线，然后坐在了沙发上。

sentences.en: I thought about how strangely simple the detective work turned out to be in the end.
sentences.zh: 我心想，这侦探工作到头来怎么会变得如此简单。

sentences.en: These questions had haunted me for most of my life, and yet here I was, idly sitting at home, and the names of brothers and sisters were suddenly appearing.
sentences.zh: 这些问题纠缠了我大半生，可我此时此刻却只是闲坐在家里，兄弟姐妹的名字突然就浮现了出来。

sentences.en: My phone buzzed with a text message.
sentences.zh: 我的手机震动了一下，收到一条短信。

sentences.en: This is your brother, Chris, it said.
sentences.zh: 短信写道，我是你哥哥克里斯。

sentences.en: I'm here with your dad, and he wants to talk.
sentences.zh: 我和你爸爸在一起，他想跟你谈谈。

sentences.en: The sun had set a few minutes before, but in the tropics there is no twilight, and day turns to night like someone has flipped a light switch.
sentences.zh: 太阳几分钟前刚刚落下，但在热带是没有黄昏的，黑夜说来就来，就像有人按下了电灯开关。

sentences.en: I picked up the phone in Columbia and dialed a number in Los Angeles.
sentences.zh: 我在哥伦比亚拿起电话，拨通了一个洛杉矶的号码。

sentences.en: It was Chris, I heard first on the other end of the line.
sentences.zh: 电话那头我最先听到的是克里斯的声音。

sentences.en: Then there was some rustling in the background, and I could hear another voice approaching the receiver.
sentences.zh: 接着背景里传来一阵沙沙声，我能听到另一个人正向话筒走来。

sentences.en: I spoke firSt.
sentences.zh: 我先开了口。

sentences.en: Dad.
sentences.zh: 爸。

sentences.en: I didn't ask it as a question.
sentences.zh: 我并不是用疑问的语气问的。

sentences.en: I knew he was there.
sentences.zh: 我知道他在那里。

sentences.en: I had just wanted to say,
sentences.zh: 我只是想说，

sentences.en: Dad.
sentences.zh: 爸。

sentences.en: Kid, he said.
sentences.zh: 孩子，他说。

sentences.en: His voice broke through the line lower and more gravelly than I remembered it.
sentences.zh: 他的声音透过电话线传过来，比我记忆中更加低沉沙哑。

sentences.en: At times, I had trouble making out what he was saying.
sentences.zh: 有时，我很难听清他在说些什么。

sentences.en: There seemed to be so much of it and no pauses between the ideas.
sentences.zh: 他似乎有说不完的话，观点之间没有任何停顿。

sentences.en: I was trying to write them down, record anything I could.
sentences.zh: 我拼命想把它们记下来，记录下我能捕捉到的一切。

sentences.en: I had played this scene over in my mind so many times in my life, as a child, as a teenager, as an adult, and each time the gravity of that imagined moment seemed to grow deeper.
sentences.zh: 在我的一生中，我曾在脑海中无数次排演过这一幕，作为一个孩子，一个青少年，一个成年人，每一次，那个想象中的时刻都显得愈发沉重。

sentences.en: Yet now there was a casualness in his words that I instantly remembered.
sentences.zh: 然而现在，他的话语中却透着一种我瞬间唤醒的随性。

sentences.en: He spoke as if only a few months had passed since I last saw him.
sentences.zh: 他的语气仿佛距离我上次见到他只过去了几个月。

sentences.en: I said,
sentences.zh: 我说，

sentences.en: Kid, one of these days, everything was gonna hook up, and you'd find me.
sentences.zh: 孩子，总有一天，所有的线索都会串联起来，你会找到我的。

sentences.en: It's that last name, Wimberly.
sentences.zh: 就是那个姓氏，温伯利。

sentences.en: You can outrun the law, but you can't outrun that name, he said.
sentences.zh: 你可以逃过法律的制裁，但你逃不掉那个姓氏，他说。

sentences.en: Wimberly is real then, I asked.
sentences.zh: 那温伯利是真的咯，我问。

sentences.en: Yes, he said, Wimberly is real.
sentences.zh: 是的，他说，温伯利是真的。

sentences.en: What about Nicholas, I asked.
sentences.zh: 那尼古拉斯呢，我问。

sentences.en: Nicholas was not his name, he said, but he'd always gone by Nick.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯不是他的名字，他说，但他一直叫尼克。

sentences.en: His real name was Novert.
sentences.zh: 他的真名叫诺弗特。

sentences.en: And Ortega?
sentences.zh: 还有奥尔特加？

sentences.en: He laughed when I said Ortega.
sentences.zh: 当我提到奥尔特加时，他笑了。

sentences.en: That was mostly a made-up name, he said.
sentences.zh: 那大多是个编造的名字，他说。

sentences.en: In the 1970s, he started using it because it sounded cool.
sentences.zh: 在二十世纪七十年代，他开始用这个名字，因为听起来很酷。

sentences.en: He told his story from the beginning.
sentences.zh: 他从头讲起了自己的故事。

sentences.en: He was born in Oklahoma City in 1940.
sentences.zh: 他于1940年出生在俄克拉荷马城。

sentences.en: He never met another Novert other than his father, whom he'd been named for, but thought it might be a Choctaw name.
sentences.zh: 除了以他父亲名字命名的自己外，他再没见过第二个叫诺弗特的人，但他觉得这可能是一个乔克托族的名字。

sentences.en: His last name, Wimberly, also came from his father, who had died of an illness in 1944 when my father was four.
sentences.zh: 他的姓氏温伯利也来自他的父亲，父亲在我父亲四岁时的1944年因病去世。

sentences.en: He was raised by two women, his mother, Connie, and his grandmother, the imperious anchor of the family who went by Honey Mom.
sentences.zh: 他是由两个女人抚养长大的，他的母亲康妮，以及他的祖母——那个被称为“亲爱的妈妈”、身为家族威严支柱的长辈。

sentences.en: The women wanted out of Oklahoma, and my father said even he saw it was no safe place for a black child.
sentences.zh: 女人们想要离开俄克拉荷马，我父亲说，连他自己也看得出，这对一个黑人孩子来说绝不是个安全的地方。

sentences.en: With the end of World War II came the chance.
sentences.zh: 随着二战的结束，机会来了。

sentences.en: The whole world was like a matrix, everything moving in every direction, he said, with a wave of black families moving west to put distance between themselves
sentences.zh: 整个世界就像一个矩阵，一切都在向各个方向移动，他说，大批黑人家庭向西迁徙，以此来拉开他们与

sentences.en: and the ghosts of slavery.
sentences.zh: 奴役阴影的距离。

sentences.en: The train ride to Phoenix was his first trip.
sentences.zh: 坐火车的菲尼克斯之旅是他的第一次远行。

sentences.en: They settled into the home of Honey Mom's aunt.
sentences.zh: 他们在“亲爱的妈妈”的姑妈家安顿下来。

sentences.en: My father came of age on the streets of Arizona, among kids speaking Spanish, Navajo, and Pima, all of which he said he could defend himself in still.
sentences.zh: 我父亲在亚利桑那的街头长大，身边的孩子说着西班牙语、纳瓦霍语和皮马语，他说直到现在他还能用这些语言为自己辩护。

sentences.en: At 16, he joined the Marine Corps, lying about his age.
sentences.zh: 16岁时，他谎报年龄加入了海军陆战队。

sentences.en: I always had this wanderlust thing in my soul, he said.
sentences.zh: 我的灵魂里一直有一种漫游癖，他说。

sentences.en: Yes, I had a lot more family, he said.
sentences.zh: 是的，我还有更多的家人，他说。

sentences.en: He'd had what he proudly called a busy, baby-making life, fathering six children who had four different mothers.
sentences.zh: 他过着他自豪地称之为忙碌的、繁衍子孙的生活，与四个不同的母亲生了六个孩子。

sentences.en: My eldest brother, Chris, came in 1960 when my father was barely 20.
sentences.zh: 我最大的哥哥克里斯出生于1960年，当时我父亲还不到20岁。

sentences.en: My sister, Terry, was born in 1965,
sentences.zh: 我姐姐特里出生于1965年，

sentences.en: Tasha in 1966,
sentences.zh: 塔莎出生于1966年，

sentences.en: Rodrigo in 1967, before me was Dakota in 1983.
sentences.zh: 罗德里戈出生于1967年，在我出生之前是1983年的达科他。

sentences.en: I was the youngeSt.
sentences.zh: 我是老幺。

sentences.en: He had many grandchildren, more than a dozen, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说他有很多孙辈，足足有十几个。

sentences.en: The whole family, all the half-siblings, the nephews, and the nieces, they all knew one another, he said.
sentences.zh: 全家人，所有的同父异母或同母异父的兄弟姐妹、侄子侄女，大家互相都认识，他说。

sentences.en: Everyone got along.
sentences.zh: 每个人都相处得很好。

sentences.en: Everyone knows everyone except Nick, he said.
sentences.zh: 除了尼克，每个人都认识所有人，他说。

sentences.en: We couldn't find Nick.
sentences.zh: 我们找不到尼克。

sentences.en: I was right here, I thought.
sentences.zh: 我就在这里，我想。

sentences.en: He must have sensed the silence on my end of the line, because he turned his story back to that night at the port of Crockett, the last we had seen of him.
sentences.zh: 他一定察觉到了我这边电话里的沉默，于是把话题转回了克罗克特港的那晚——那是我们最后一次见到他。

sentences.en: The trouble had come a few months before, he said, when he was between jobs on the ships.
sentences.zh: 麻烦是在几个月前发生的，他说，当时他正在船上待业。

sentences.en: A woman outside his apartment asked him if he had a cigarette, then suddenly ran away.
sentences.zh: 他公寓外的一个女人问他有没有烟，然后突然跑开了。

sentences.en: A man appeared, an estranged husband or lover, my father suspected, who thought there was something between her and my father, and now came after him.
sentences.zh: 一个男人出现了，我父亲猜那是一个分居的丈夫或情夫，他以为那个女人和我父亲之间有什么，于是现在来找我父亲算账。

sentences.en: My father drew a gun he had.
sentences.zh: 我父亲拔出了一把枪。

sentences.en: The man backed away, and my father closed the door, but the man tried to break it down.
sentences.zh: 那个人退了回去，我父亲关上了门，但那个人试图把门撞开。

sentences.en: I said, if you hit this door again,
sentences.zh: 我说，如果你再砸这扇门，

sentences.en: I'm going to blow your ass away, my father recalled.
sentences.zh: 我非崩了你不可，我父亲回忆道。

sentences.en: Then he pulled the trigger.
sentences.zh: 然后他扣动了扳机。

sentences.en: My father said he took a manslaughter plea bargain and served 30 days behind bars and three years on probation.
sentences.zh: 我父亲说他接受了过失杀人的认罪协商，在监狱里服刑30天，并接受了三年缓刑。

sentences.en: And then?
sentences.zh: 然后呢？

sentences.en: I asked.
sentences.zh: 我问。

sentences.en: He'd had so many answers until that point, but now he grew quiet.
sentences.zh: 在那之前他有那么多的答案，但现在他沉默了。

sentences.en: He said he'd come our way several times on the ships and had even driven down to the row of mobile home parks beside the highway.
sentences.zh: 他说他乘船来过我们这边好几次，甚至开车去过高速公路旁那一排移动房屋公园。

sentences.en: But he couldn't remember which one was ours, he said.
sentences.zh: 但他记不清哪一个是我们的了，他说。

sentences.en: He felt he'd made a mess of things.
sentences.zh: 他觉得自己把事情搞得一团糟。

sentences.en: He didn't want the fact that my father had killed someone to follow me around.
sentences.zh: 他不想让父亲杀过人的事缠着我。

sentences.en: My mother hadn't really wanted him to be around, he said.
sentences.zh: 我母亲其实并不想让他在附近，他说。

sentences.en: He grew quiet.
sentences.zh: 他沉默了。

sentences.en: He seemed to have run out of reasons.
sentences.zh: 他似乎已经找不出什么理由了。

sentences.en: I never really knew my dad, he said.
sentences.zh: 我从来没有真正了解过我爸爸，他说。

sentences.en: There are times when a father cannot explain why he abandoned his son.
sentences.zh: 有时候，父亲无法解释他为什么要抛弃儿子。

sentences.en: It felt too late to confront him.
sentences.zh: 现在去质问他感觉太迟了。

sentences.en: It was getting close to midnight.
sentences.zh: 快到午夜了。

sentences.en: He was 77 years old.
sentences.zh: 他已经77岁了。

sentences.en: I'll never forget, Nicholas, the last night I saw you, kid, he said.
sentences.zh: 尼古拉斯，我永远不会忘记我见到你的最后一晚，孩子，他说。

sentences.en: It was a foggy night when we came back and I had to walk back to the ship.
sentences.zh: 那是个起雾的夜晚，我们回来了，我得步行回船上。

sentences.en: And I gave you a big hug and I gave your mom a big hug.
sentences.zh: 我给了你一个大大的拥抱，也给你妈妈一个大大的拥抱。

sentences.en: And it was a foggy night and I was walking back and I could barely see the traces of you and your mother.
sentences.zh: 那是个起雾的夜晚，我往回走着，几乎快看不清你和你母亲的身影了。

sentences.en: He and I said goodbye and I hung up the phone.
sentences.zh: 我和他道了别，然后挂断了电话。

sentences.en: I was suddenly aware of how alone I was in the apartment, of the sound of the clock ticking on the wall.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到自己在这个公寓里是多么孤单，墙上时钟的滴答声清晰可闻。

sentences.en: I got up from the desk and for a few minutes just stood there.
sentences.zh: 我从书桌旁站起来，站在那里呆了足足几分钟。

sentences.en: I couldn't believe how fast it had all happened.
sentences.zh: 我简直不敢相信这一切发生得这么快。

sentences.en: For decades, this man had been the great mystery of my life.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，这个男人一直是我生命中最大的谜团。

sentences.en: I had spent years trying to solve the riddle, then spent years trying to accept that the riddle could not be solved.
sentences.zh: 我花了多年时间试图解开这个谜，然后又花了多年时间试着接受这个谜根本无解的事实。

sentences.en: And now, with what felt like nearly no effort at all,
sentences.zh: 而现在，几乎没费什么力气，

sentences.en: I'd conjured him on a phone call.
sentences.zh: 我通过一通电话就把他给“召唤”出来了。

sentences.en: I was looking at the notes
sentences.zh: 我看着自己记下的笔记，

sentences.en: I'd taken, repeating a few of the things out loud.
sentences.zh: 大声重复着其中的几件事。

sentences.en: A vague outline of this man's life starting in 1940.
sentences.zh: 这个男人从1940年开始的人生轨迹的大致轮廓。

sentences.en: A half dozen dates and cities, a few street names.
sentences.zh: 六个日期和城市，还有几个街名。

sentences.en: My father had killed someone,
sentences.zh: 我父亲杀过人，

sentences.en: I'd written.
sentences.zh: 我写道。

sentences.en: That part was true.
sentences.zh: 那部分是真的。

sentences.en: He said he came looking for our home, but there was something about the tone in his voice that made me doubt this.
sentences.zh: 他说他来找过我们的家，但他语气中的某种调子让我对此产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: And then there was the name Ortega, which I had underlined several times.
sentences.zh: 还有那个我划了好几道杠的名字——奥尔特加。

sentences.en: Ortega was not his name.
sentences.zh: 奥尔特加根本不是他的名字。

sentences.en: I took a moment to sit with that.
sentences.zh: 我花了一点时间来消化这件事。

sentences.en: I had followed that name to Havana as a teenager and into a guerrilla camp in the mountains of Columbia as an adult.
sentences.zh: 我曾在少年时期为了这个名字追到哈瓦那，成年后又追到了哥伦比亚山区的游击队营地。

sentences.en: I had told old girlfriends that the reason I danced salsa was because I was Latino.
sentences.zh: 我曾告诉前女友们，我跳萨尔萨舞是因为我是拉丁裔。

sentences.en: And if they believed it, then it was because I did too.
sentences.zh: 如果她们信了，那也是因为我自己深信不疑。

sentences.en: In the end, fate had a sense of humor.
sentences.zh: 到头来，命运还真挺有幽默感的。

sentences.en: I had finally followed the Ortega name back to its origin.
sentences.zh: 我最终还是顺着奥尔特加这个名字找到了它的源头。

sentences.en: Not Cuba at all, but the whim of a young man in the 1970s who just wanted to seem cool.
sentences.zh: 根本不是什么古巴，不过是二十世纪七十年代一个只想显得很酷的年轻人的心血来潮罢了。

sentences.en: Four weeks after that call, I was outside Los Angeles waiting to see my father.
sentences.zh: 那通电话四周后，我在洛杉矶郊外等待与父亲见面。

sentences.en: Our meeting point was a jack-in-the-box parking lot.
sentences.zh: 我们的会面地点是一个快餐店的停车场。

sentences.en: There had been no rush to a port this time and it was I, not he, who came from overseas on a bumpy Avianca flight out of Medellin.
sentences.zh: 这一次没有急着赶往港口，是我而不是他，坐着从麦德林起飞颠簸的阿维安卡航空航班从海外赶来。

sentences.en: It had been 26 years since I last saw him.
sentences.zh: 距离我上次见到他已经过去26年了。

sentences.en: A four-door car pulled up, a window rolled down, and suddenly my father became real again, squeezed into the front seat of the car with one long arm stretched out of the window
sentences.zh: 一辆四门轿车停了下来，车窗摇下，突然之间，我的父亲又变得真实起来，他挤在汽车的前排座位上，一条长长的胳膊伸出窗外，

sentences.en: holding a cigarillo.
sentences.zh: 手里夹着一支细雪茄。

sentences.en: Someone honked trying to get into the drive-thru lane.
sentences.zh: 有人按喇叭想挤进得来速车道。

sentences.en: I barely registered the horn.
sentences.zh: 我几乎没注意到那个喇叭声。

sentences.en: My father's face, which I'd forgotten years ago, was restored.
sentences.zh: 我多年未见而淡忘的父亲的脸，此刻重新清晰起来。

sentences.en: He had a stubby nose and big ears.
sentences.zh: 他有着蒜头鼻和大耳朵。

sentences.en: He had wiry white hair, which he relaxed and combed back until it turned up again at the back of his neck.
sentences.zh: 他有着硬邦邦的白发，被他用发油梳向脑后，直到在脖子后方又翘了起来。

sentences.en: The ears had made him incredibly lean.
sentences.zh: 那些耳朵让他显得格外精瘦。

sentences.en: He had dentures now.
sentences.zh: 他现在戴着假牙。

sentences.en: Get on in, kid, he shouted as he came out and put his arms around me.
sentences.zh: 上车吧，孩子，他一边说着一边走下车，张开双臂抱住了我。

sentences.en: We got in the car and Chris, my brother, drove us to his home where my dad had been living for the last few weeks, planning his next journey to Guam.
sentences.zh: 我们上了车，我哥哥克里斯开车把我们送到了他家，我爸爸过去几周一直住在那里，正计划着他前往关岛的下一段旅程。

sentences.en: The next morning, I found my father on Chris's couch.
sentences.zh: 第二天早上，我在克里斯的沙发上找到了我父亲。

sentences.en: His time at sea made him dislike regular beds, he explained.
sentences.zh: 他解释说，在海上的日子让他不喜欢睡普通的床。

sentences.en: Next to him in two unzipped suitcases were what seemed to be the sum total of his possessions, which included a kimono from Japan, two sperm whale teeth he bought in Singapore,
sentences.zh: 在他旁边放着两个没拉拉链的行李箱，里面似乎装着他的全部身家，包括一件来自日本的和服、两颗他在新加坡买的抹香鲸牙齿，

sentences.en: and a photo album that included pictures of his travels over the last 40 years and ended in a run to McMurdo Station in Antarctica in the years before he retired in 2009.
sentences.zh: 还有一本相册，里面记录了他过去40年的旅行照片，并在2009年退休前夕去南极洲麦克默多站的行程中画上了句号。

sentences.en: He was putting on the kimono, he handed the album to me.
sentences.zh: 他正穿上那件和服，顺手把相册递给了我。

sentences.en: He went into a closet near the couch and pulled out a bottle of rum, took a long swig and shook it off.
sentences.zh: 他走到沙发旁的一个衣柜前，拿出一瓶朗姆酒，大口喝了起来，然后甩了甩头。

sentences.en: It was 9 a.m.
sentences.zh: 当时是早上9点。

sentences.en: Good morning, kid, he said.
sentences.zh: 早安，孩子，他说。

sentences.en: He'd pulled out a stack of old birth certificates from our ancestors, family pictures and logs he kept from the ports he visited that he wanted to show me.
sentences.zh: 他掏出一叠我们祖先的旧出生证明、家庭照片以及他保存的去过的港口的航海日志，想要给我看。

sentences.en: We spent the morning in the backyard together, leafing through this family history he'd been carrying around in his suitcase.
sentences.zh: 我们一起在后院度过了整个上午，翻看着他一直塞在行李箱里的这段家族历史。

sentences.en: My father and I now talk every week or two, as I expect most fathers and sons do.
sentences.zh: 现在我和父亲每隔一两周就会通一次话，我想大多数父子也是如此。

sentences.en: The calls haven't always been easy.
sentences.zh: 这些电话并不总是那么轻松。

sentences.en: There are times when I see his number appear on my phone and I just don't answer.
sentences.zh: 有时候我看到他的电话号码出现在手机上，我就是不接。

sentences.en: I know I should, but there were so many moments as a child when I picked up the phone hoping it would be my father.
sentences.zh: 我知道我应该接，但在我小时候的很多时刻，我拿起电话时都多么希望能是我的父亲。

sentences.en: Not long ago, his number flashed on my screen.
sentences.zh: 不久前，他的号码在我的屏幕上闪烁。

sentences.en: It suddenly hit me that the area code was the same as a number I used to have when I lived in Los Angeles after college.
sentences.zh: 我突然意识到，这个区号和我大学毕业后住在洛杉矶时用的号码一模一样。

sentences.en: He'd been there those years too, he said.
sentences.zh: 他说，那几年他也在那里。

sentences.en: He had no idea how devastated I was to know this.
sentences.zh: 他完全不知道我知道这件事时内心有多崩溃。

sentences.en: For two years, his home was only a half hour's drive from me.
sentences.zh: 有两年时间，他的家离我只有半小时的车程。

sentences.en: And if I'm truly honest,
sentences.zh: 如果我说的是实话，

sentences.en: I'm not sure what to make of the fact that this man was present in the lives of his five other children but not mine.
sentences.zh: 我不知道该如何看待这样一个事实：这个男人陪伴了他另外五个孩子的成长，却没有陪伴我。

sentences.en: Part of me would really like to confront him about it, to have a big showdown with the old man like the one I tried to have in my dream years ago.
sentences.zh: 我内心里有一部分真的很想当面质问他，想和这个老头大干一场，就像我多年前在梦里试过的那样。

sentences.en: But I also don't know quite what would come of confronting him.
sentences.zh: 但我也完全不知道质问他会带来什么结果。

sentences.en: He's a modern-day pirate, my brother Chris likes to say, which has the ring of one of those lines that has been repeated for decades in a family.
sentences.zh: 我哥哥克里斯喜欢说，他是个当代的强盗，这话听起来就像是那种在家族里流传了几十年的老笑话。

sentences.en: Once after I met my sister Tasha for dinner with my father, he stepped out for a smoke and she began to tell me about what she remembered of him growing up.
sentences.zh: 有一次，我和姐姐塔莎跟父亲一起吃过晚饭后，他出去抽烟，塔莎便开始跟我讲她记忆中自己成长过程中的父亲。

sentences.en: He appeared time and again at her mother's house between his adventures at sea.
sentences.zh: 在他在海上历险的间隙，他一次又一次地出现在她母亲的家里。

sentences.en: She remembered magical little walks with him in the parks in Pasadena where they looked for eucalyptus seed pods that he told her fairies like to hide in.
sentences.zh: 她记得自己曾和他一起在帕萨蒂ナ的公园里度过神奇的小小散步时光，他们在那里寻找桉树的种荚，他告诉她仙女喜欢藏在里面。

sentences.en: Then one day he said he was going on a ship but didn't come back.
sentences.zh: 然后有一天，他说他要上一艘船，却再也没有回来。

sentences.en: It sounded a lot like the story of my childhood with One Big Difference.
sentences.zh: 这听起来很像我的童年故事，但有一个重大区别。

sentences.en: Tasha learned a few years later that he had been living at the home of Chris's mother to whom he was still married.
sentences.zh: 塔莎几年后才知道，他一直住在克里斯的母亲家里，他当时和她并没有离婚。

sentences.en: He never went on a ship after all.
sentences.zh: 他根本就没去上船。

sentences.en: Or he did but didn't bother to return to Tasha afterward.
sentences.zh: 或者说他去了，只是之后懒得再回塔莎身边。

sentences.en: The truth surprised her at first but then she realized it shouldn't have.
sentences.zh: 真相起初让她感到震惊，但随后她意识到本不该如此。

sentences.en: It fit with what she had come to expect from him.
sentences.zh: 这很符合她对他的期望。

sentences.en: I spent much of my life imagining who I was and then becoming that person through vague clues about who my father was.
sentences.zh: 我的大半生都在通过关于我父亲是谁的模糊线索，去想象自己是谁，然后成为那样的人。

sentences.en: These impressions led me to high school
sentences.zh: 这些印象引导我走进了高中

sentences.en: Spanish classes and to that class trip to Cuba.
sentences.zh: 西班牙语课堂，并参加了去古巴的班级旅行。

sentences.en: They had sent me traveling to Latin America and making a life and career there.
sentences.zh: 它们促使我前往拉丁美洲旅行，并在那里生活和发展事业。

sentences.en: For a while after learning the truth about who my father was, a black man from Oklahoma, I wondered whether that changed something essential about me.
sentences.zh: 在得知我父亲真实身份——一个来自俄克拉荷马州的黑人——之后的很长一段时间里，我一直在想，这是否改变了我身上的某些本质东西。

sentences.en: Part of me wants to think that it shouldn't.
sentences.zh: 我内心的一部分希望这不应该改变。

sentences.en: It's the part of me that secretly liked being an only child because I thought it made me unique in the world.
sentences.zh: 正是这部分我私下里很喜欢做独生子女，因为我以为这让我在世界上显得独一无二。

sentences.en: And even though I have five siblings now, that part of me still likes to believe we each determine who we are by the decisions we make and the lives we choose to live.
sentences.zh: 尽管我现在有五个兄弟姐妹，但我内心深处仍然愿意相信，我们每个人都是由自己做出的决定和选择过的人生来决定自己是谁的。

sentences.en: But what if we don't?
sentences.zh: 但如果不是这样呢？

sentences.en: Now I often wonder whether this long journey that has led me to so many corners of the world wasn't because I was searching for him but because I am him.
sentences.zh: 现在我经常在想，这场把我带到世界这么多角落的长途旅行，不是因为我在寻找他，而是因为我就是他。

sentences.en: Whether the part of my father that compelled him to spend his life at sea
sentences.zh: 我父亲那部分迫使他把一生奉献给大海的性格，

sentences.en: is the part of me that led me to an itinerant life as a foreign correspondent.
sentences.zh: 正是那部分引导我过上了作为外派记者的四处奔波的生活。

sentences.en: It
sentences.zh: 这

sentences.en: is strange to hear my father's voice over the phone because it can sound like an older version of mine and not just in the tone but in the pauses and the way he leaps
sentences.zh: 在电话里听到父亲的声音感觉很奇怪，因为它听起来就像是我声音的老年版，不仅仅是语气，还有停顿的方式以及他毫无预兆地

sentences.en: from one story to another with no warning.
sentences.zh: 从一个故事跳到另一个故事的方式。

sentences.en: We spent a lifetime apart and yet somehow our tastes have converged on pastrami sandwiches and fried shrimp foods we've never eaten together before now.
sentences.zh: 我们一生都在分离，然而不知为何，我们的口味却不约而同地汇聚到了熏牛肉三明治和炸虾上——这些食物我们以前从没一起吃过。

sentences.en: He shocked me one night when he mentioned the Hokulea the canoe built in Hawaii which had figured in my college honors thesis about modern navigators.
sentences.zh: 一天晚上，他提到夏威夷建造独木舟“霍库莱阿号”时把我震惊了，这艘独木舟曾在我的关于现代航海家的大学荣誉论文中出现过。

sentences.en: I'd considered it an obscure absolutely solitary obsession of mine and yet he appeared to know as much about it as I did.
sentences.zh: 我一直认为这是一个偏门且绝对孤立的个人痴迷，然而他似乎和我一样了解它。

sentences.en: Keep your log he often says at the end of our calls reminding me to write down where my travels have taken me.
sentences.zh: “记好你的航海日志，”他经常在我们的通话结束时这样说，提醒我写下我的旅行带我去过的地方。

sentences.en: These days I live in Spain as the New York Times
sentences.zh: 如今我住在西班牙，担任《纽约时报》

sentences.en: Madrid bureau chief but in May I returned to California to see my father.
sentences.zh: 马德里分社社长，但在五月我回到了加利福尼亚看望父亲。

sentences.en: He had gone to live in Guam then moved to the Bahamas.
sentences.zh: 他曾去关岛生活，然后搬到了巴哈马。

sentences.en: And Florida and now was back in California on Chris's couch.
sentences.zh: 还有佛罗里达，现在又回到了加利福尼亚，住在克里斯的沙发上。

sentences.en: His wanderlust seemed to have no limits even now that he was in his 80s.
sentences.zh: 即使已经八十多岁了，他的旅行瘾似乎依然没有极限。

sentences.en: We were driving down the highway in a rented car when I turned on
sentences.zh: 我们开着租来的车在高速公路上行驶，我打开了

sentences.en: Beethoven's
sentences.zh: 贝多芬的

sentences.en: Emperor Concerto on Spotify.
sentences.zh: 《皇帝协奏曲》Spotify版。

sentences.en: I started to hum the orchestra part.
sentences.zh: 我开始哼唱管弦乐队的部分。

sentences.en: I've listened to the piece for years.
sentences.zh: 这首曲子我已经听了好几年。

sentences.en: Then I noticed my dad was humming along too
